title: Add destination_v29: a run-end ghost pay linear in the gap
summary: destination_v29 is destination_v28 whose run-end pay is linear in the gap to the ghost: share * max(1 - d / 25 mm, -1), 1 at the ghost, 0 at 25 mm and -1 from 50 mm, still weighted by the share of the run done. destination_v28's narrow kernel paid about 0.07 at 30 mm and barely changed there; its update-600 surrogate checkpoint falls 31 mm behind the ghost in the first second of a 0.15 m/s walk and holds the lag, and its 0.05 m/s walk ends 5.08 mm from the ghost.
next: Fine-tune the destination_v28 update-600 surrogate checkpoint and test it against v9.
reason: A named experiment that no gate or registry entry uses yet; the canonical task, reward and evaluator are unchanged.
